title: Jazzy French Chicken Bouillon
description: A silky, show-off polish dish featuring rich flavors and tender chicken. Serve with crusty bread on the side for dipping into the broth.
instructions: Heat butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add flour and cook, whisking constantly, for 2 minutes.
Gradually pour in white wine, whisking continuously, and cook until the liquid is almost completely reduced, about 5 minutes.
Add chicken bouillon powder and whisk to combine.
Add chicken thighs and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Pour in heavy cream and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let cook, covered, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened slightly, about 10-12 minutes.
Stir in thyme, salt, and pepper.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Garnish with parsley and serve hot with crusty bread on the side.
Let the bouillon rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to mature.
